name: Classical & Jazz Dynamic
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: Keeps the full dynamic range of orchestral, chamber and jazz recordings. There is no maximizer drive, no clipper and no compression: only a slow, transparent limiter at -1 dBTP, a little warmth for cello and double bass, a touch of air, and crossfeed that makes hard-panned vintage jazz stereo comfortable on headphones.
